title: Add a dark mode theme to the web app
body: Please add a dark mode theme option in settings so the interface is easier on the eyes at night. A toggle between light and dark would be ideal.

title: Dark mode theme option for the interface
body: The web app needs a dark mode theme. Add a light and dark toggle in settings so the interface is easier on the eyes at night.

title: Export report data to CSV
body: I want to export the report table to a CSV file so I can open the data in a spreadsheet and share it with my team.

title: CSV export for report tables
body: Add a button to export report data as a CSV file. Opening the exported data in a spreadsheet to share with the team is the main use case.

title: Login fails when using SAML SSO
body: Signing in through SAML single sign-on fails with an error after the identity provider redirect. Password login still works.

title: SAML single sign-on login broken
body: SSO login through SAML fails with an error right after the identity provider redirect. Regular password login is unaffected.

title: Cannot sign in with SSO identity provider
body: Login through the SAML SSO identity provider fails after redirect with an error. Password sign in works fine.

title: App crashes on startup after the latest update
body: Since updating to the latest version the desktop app crashes immediately on startup before the main window appears.

title: Desktop app crashes immediately on launch after update
body: After the latest update the app crashes on startup. It closes before the main window appears every time I launch it.

title: Dashboard takes very long to load
body: The main dashboard page takes more than ten seconds to load when an account has many projects. It used to be fast.

title: Slow dashboard load for large accounts
body: Dashboard load is very slow, over ten seconds, for accounts with many projects. The page used to load fast.

title: Return rate limit headers on API responses
body: The REST API should return rate limit headers so clients can see their remaining quota and back off before hitting a limit.

title: Expose remaining quota via API rate limit headers
body: Add rate limit headers to REST API responses so clients know their remaining quota and can back off before they hit the limit.

title: Search returns nothing when filtering by tag
body: Using the tag filter in search always returns an empty result set even when items with that tag clearly exist.

title: Notification emails have broken HTML formatting
body: The notification emails arrive with raw HTML tags visible in the body instead of rendered formatting.

title: Support two-factor authentication with an authenticator app
body: Add TOTP two-factor authentication so users can secure their account with an authenticator app instead of only SMS.

title: Bulk delete for archived projects
body: Allow selecting multiple archived projects and deleting them in one action instead of one at a time.

title: Webhook deliveries are not retried on failure
body: When a webhook endpoint returns a 500 the delivery is dropped and never retried, so events are silently lost.

title: Report timestamps show the wrong timezone
body: Timestamps in generated reports are rendered in UTC rather than the account timezone configured in settings.

title: Keyboard shortcuts for navigating between views
body: Add keyboard shortcuts to jump between the main views so power users can navigate without the mouse.

title: PDF export is missing page numbers
body: Documents exported to PDF do not include page numbers in the footer, which makes long exports hard to reference.

title: Avatar upload rejects images over 1 MB without a message
body: Uploading a profile avatar larger than 1 MB silently fails with no error shown to the user.

title: Allow inviting users by email in bulk
body: Add a way to paste a list of email addresses and send workspace invitations to all of them at once.

title: Audit log for administrative actions
body: Provide an audit log that records administrative actions like role changes and connector edits with a timestamp and actor.
